title: fix(spec): the connector read withholds root keys the entry shape does not declare
body:

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:connector 元数据的读取脱敏(`redactConnectorItem`)现在整键扣下条目 schema 未声明的顶层键;`providerConfig` 下装有带凭据 URL 的数组也整体扣下。
- 为什么改:读取侧加固,与 #28688 的写入侧收紧配套,让所有读出口只返回条目 schema 声明过的顶层键。
- 风险与回滚:读出口少返回未声明的顶层键;被扣的键记入 `redactedKeys`,保存时由 carry-forward 原样保留在库里,运行时执行读不受影响。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/integration/connector-credential-redaction.ts`(`credentialPathsOf` 顶层键循环与 `credentialUrlRewritesOf` 数组分支)→ `packages/qa/dogfood/test/connector-meta-door-root-key-read.dogfood.test.ts` → `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.metadata-redaction.test.ts` 末尾新块。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/integration/connector-credential-redaction.test.ts`,预期 41 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(本 PR 待席位做 contract review)。

## What changes

Read-side hardening of the built-in `connector` redactor in `@objectstack/spec`:

- **Undeclared top-level keys are withheld whole.** The declared set is read from the closed entry schema itself (`DeclarativeConnectorEntrySchema`'s read-through `shape`, built from `connectorBaseShape`), never a hand-written list, so a key the entry declares later is served with nothing to edit. The read decorations (`METADATA_READ_DECORATIONS`: `_diagnostics`, `_draft`) are the response's and are left alone; the ADR-0010 protection envelope is declared in the shape and is served as before. A cleared value (`null`, `''`, an empty map) is served as written and not reported, the module's existing convention.
- **Each withheld key is named in `redactedKeys`**, so the protocol's carry-forward keeps the stored value at rest on a save of the served form. The save door order is unchanged: strip read decorations, then the schema gate judges the author's body, then the carry-forward restores the stored key.
- **Under `providerConfig`, an array that holds (at any depth) a URL whose credential parts the URL rewrite would remove is withheld whole**, the posture a non-object `auth` already has. An array holding no such URL is served as stored. The previous pin that served such arrays is flipped deliberately.
- Module docblock items 6 and 7 record both positions.

No public export changes; nothing an author can write changes.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/integration/connector-credential-redaction.test.ts`: withholds undeclared root keys on read (credential-shaped scalar, several keys, nested container, plain key); the declared set equals the entry schema's shape; read decorations untouched; cleared forms served; combined positions each named once; the array pin flipped (array withheld whole at any depth, a URL-free array served).
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.metadata-redaction.test.ts`: the item read, the list read (both spellings) and the layered read withhold the keys; a save of the served form keeps them at rest; a key the author types is refused with `INVALID_METADATA` / 422 and the row is unchanged; identity-redactor ablation arm.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.diff-credential-redaction.test.ts`: the history diff, all three buckets, reports the path and serves neither value; identity-redactor ablation arm.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/connector-meta-door-root-key-read.dogfood.test.ts`: the showcase's HTTP read doors (`/meta/connector/:name`, `/layers`, `/meta/connector`, `/meta/connectors`, `/diff`) for a member and an administrator, with the row seeded directly in storage; a save of the served form keeps the keys at rest.

## Acceptance notes

- A top-level key spelled with a dot is withheld on read, but the carry-forward addresses positions by dotted path and cannot address it, so a save of the served form does not keep such a key at rest. Such a key is undeclared, read by nothing at runtime, and refused by the closed entry at every authoring door.
- The history diff keeps a withheld key's path in its bucket with the value absent, the same posture the diff already has for every redacted position (diff raw, emit redacted values).
- The branch started from the head of #28688 (the closed entry shape this redaction reads its declared set from). That PR landed before this one opened, and `origin/main` was merged in (a merge, no rewrite), so this PR carries no stacked dependency.
